units.title: unless / as long as / provided that
units.shortDescription: Если не / при условии что — союзы условий.
units.theoryHtml:
unless = «если не» (if... not): I won't go unless you come = I won't go if you don't come. После unless — утвердительный глагол (двойное «не» запрещено!).

as long as / provided (that) / providing = «при условии, что»: You can borrow my car as long as you drive carefully. Provided that it doesn't rain, we'll play.

После всех этих союзов о будущем — Present, не will: unless it rains (не unless it will rain).

⚠ Частые ошибки: unless you don't come — двойное отрицание, ошибка. as long as you will drive → you drive. Разница с if: if нейтрально, unless — «единственное условие, при котором НЕ».

Мини-диалог:
— Will you join us? — Unless I have to work, yes.
— You can stay as long as you help with the dishes. — Provided the dishwater works!

exercises.prompt: I won't forgive you ___ you apologise.
___ it rains, we'll have the party indoors.
You can stay ___ you keep quiet.
Choose the correct sentence:
options: Unless you don't help, I can't finish.
Unless you help, I can't finish.
Unless you will help, I can't finish.
Unless you not help, I can't finish.

exercises.prompt: Provided that the flight ___ delayed, we'll be there by noon.
___ you hurry, you'll miss it. (= Если не поспешишь)
You may keep the book ___ you return it on time.
I'll come ___ I'm invited. (только если)
___ ___ (если не) it snows, the flight will be on time. (2 слова)
We'll sign the contract ___ ___ (при условии, что) the price stays the same. (2-3 слова)

units.title: so that / in order to — цель
units.shortDescription: Я пришёл, чтобы поговорить — три способа выразить цель.
units.theoryHtml:
Цель выражается тремя способами:

ФормаПример
to + инфинитивI came to talk.
in order to / so as to + инфинитивI left early in order to avoid traffic.
so that + предложениеI left early so that I could avoid traffic.

so that нужен, когда у цели своё подлежащее или модальный глагол: I'm saving money so that my kids can study. in order to звучит формально; в отрицательной цели — in order not to / so as not to: Speak slowly in order not to confuse her.

for + -ing — назначение предмета: A knife is for cutting (не цель человека!).

⚠ Частые ошибки: for to talk → to talk. in order to you understand → нужен so that: so that you understand. I go to gym for get fit → to get fit.

Мини-диалог:
— Why did you take a second job? — To save money for a house. I so that... sorry — I want a mortgage so that the bank says yes.
— I set two alarms in order not to oversleep. Dedication!

exercises.prompt: I went to the shop ___ some bread.
She saved money ___ she could travel.
He spoke slowly ___ ___ be understood. (2 слова)
This knife is ___ bread.
We whispered ___ ___ wake the baby. (не разбудить, 3 слова)
Choose the correct sentence:
options: I called in order to asking.

exercises.prompt: He studies hard ___ pass the exam.
I left early so that I ___ miss the traffic.
I got up early ___ ___ ___ (чтобы не) be late. (3 слова)
exercises.correctAnswer: in order not to|so as not to
exercises.explanation: in order not to be late.

exercises.prompt: Speak louder ___ ___ (чтобы) everyone hears you. (2 слова)

units.title: although / despite / in spite of
units.shortDescription: Хотя / несмотря на — союзы противоречия и их грамматика.
units.theoryHtml:
Слова противопоставления различаются тем, что за ними стоит:

СловоЗа нимПример
although / though / even thoughпредложение (подлежащее + глагол)Although it was late, we went out.
despite / in spite ofсуществительное или -ingDespite the late hour, we went out. Despite being tired, we went out.

Их можно «конвертировать»: Although he was tired = Despite being tired = Despite his tiredness.

though может стоять в конце предложения (= however): It was expensive. I liked it, though.

⚠ Частые ошибки: despite of → despite (БЕЗ of; of есть в in spite of). despite it was late → although it was late или despite the late hour. even although → even though.

Мини-диалог:
— Why are you smiling? Despite the failure, you look happy. — Although we lost, we played beautifully.
— And you finished the marathon, even though you injured your knee? — Yes. In spite of everything.

exercises.prompt: ___ it was raining, we went hiking.
___ the rain, we went hiking.
___ being rich, he lives simply.
The film was long. I enjoyed it, ___.
Choose the correct sentence:
options: Despite of the cold, we swam.
In spite the cold, we swam.

exercises.prompt: ___ she was tired, she kept dancing.
___ his age, he runs marathons.
___ being late, he missed the meeting. (двойная ошибка была неизбежна)
___ ___ (несмотря на) the traffic, we arrived on time. (2 слова)
___ (Хотя) he's 80, he still surfs.
